{{Top|leg}}
A '''Stop Comm order''' was a solicitude made to the government of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It was intended to help the Republic when it wanted to withhold a fact from the public when they wanted to notify the press first.

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], [[Tyro Caladian]] used a Stop Comm order to delay for three days the notification of the capture of the [[Slams]].
